items.difficulty_reason: 6 行陈述（43 行证明）、weighting 的基变换相容性：逐点展开定义化成长度恒等式、代数闭包基变换下用 separable-first 子域分解成长度等于不可分次数、pullback 长度公式沿平坦映射搬回。2 处引用全具名，无 omit，干净收。statement 的 w_alpha 定义收进 context span 1657-1668；本卡 label 本身无上游 canonical tag（快照标签表缺 0H5O 位），不影响卡内自证。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-weightings-pre (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1670-1675

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Unfold the definition of the weighting at a point of the base change and reduce the compatibility to a length identity relating the inseparable degree of the original residue field extension, the length of the tensor product of residue fields localized at the prime of the point, and the inseparable degree of the base-changed residue field extension, prove the needed equality after base change to an algebraic closure of the lower residue field using the separable-first subfield lemma which exhibits the tensor product as a product of local factors of degree equal to the inseparable degree, and transport the resulting identity back along the flat map of tensor products with the pullback formula for lengths (source lines 1677-1719)
